fp_budget_r5_2.discipline: PER ARM, NOT PER FAMILY (R5-2 and DEC-20260905-1ea7a0 Coordinator prior point 1). The named arithmetic error this design avoids is budgeting plateau-consistent sentences per family rather than per arm.
fp_budget_r5_2.plateau_price_per_arm_priced_semantics_r: PRICED SEMANTICS (bound-carrying): 0.171940 is certified over the OBJ-5A calibration family and the probed configurations, NOT as a theorem for all equal-mean configurations (RT2-F6). The worst case is a supremum attained at phi = 1.0, the degenerate homogeneous limit; over strictly heterogeneous phi > 1 it is approached as phi -> 1+ (largest swept value 0.1718971 at phi = 1.001). Residual range exactly [0.114124, 0.171940]. Plateau mass convention-invariant.
fp_budget_r5_2.decay_branch_price_priced_semantics_r5_1: PRICED SEMANTICS (bound-carrying): 0.018883 is the written-cascade-order FM-OVERDISPERSED routing price of the decay branch priced on OBJ-4 at the preregistered MDE rho = 2 at the committed constants (lambda_plan = 16, n = 4 per point, 2^30 per arm), a design-time exact enumeration independently re-derived to every reported digit, NOT a theorem for all decay alternatives.
fp_budget_r5_2.semantics_of_the_sum: ACCOUNTING SUM of per-arm budget commitments under R5-2's per-arm discipline; NOT the probability of any composite event; no sentence may quote it as one. A budget sum exceeding 1 is the expected shape of a per-arm worst-case commitment ledger over eight arms.

sentence_level_prices.note: Sentence-level prices carry their priced-semantics statements above wherever quoted.

cascade_constants.branch1_count_threshold_at_n4_lambda_op_: Reject at T >= 12 per primary point (exact Poisson(4) upper tail: P(X >= 12) = 9.152e-4 <= 0.001 < P(X >= 11) = 2.840e-3; independently reproduced exact by TASK-20260903-4fdf77 and TASK-20260904-f5b7fc FC-4). Fail-to-reject region T <= 11; at lambda_op = 1.0 Branch 1 (FM-COMPARATOR-INDISTINGUISHABLE) fires exactly when T_4 <= 11 AND T_16 <= 11.
cascade_constants.branch1_threshold_if_lambda_op_above_1: The RULE is pre-committed (one-sided exact Poisson test at alpha_N = 0.001 against mean n_k x lambda_op); if the comparator-setting step fixes lambda_op > 1.0, the numeric threshold is the first T with P(Poisson(n_k x lambda_op) >= T) <= 0.001, computed exactly from the committed rule at the lambda_op value fixed BEFORE the cascade is evaluated - a deterministic function of a pre-cascade-fixed constant, not a post-data choice.
cascade_constants.u_null_closed_form: U(T, n) = 0.5 * chi2_{0.95}(2T + 2) / n, per 2^30 (exact one-sided Garwood upper bound)
cascade_constants.lambda_op_determinism_note: At n = 6, lambda_op = lambda_0 = 1.0 exactly when the pooled null count T <= 1; T >= 2 gives lambda_op = U(T, 6) > 1.0 and every branch statement is restated against the larger value.
cascade_constants.g4_note: 39 pooled hits over the six null arms (lambda_hat_null >= 6.5 per 2^30, the exact Garwood lower bound of the committed single-arm h = 12 reading; U3/SR-4 disclosure carried: third disclosed use of the five committed readings - a gate calibration, not an evidential input)

memory_budget.basis: The campaign's standing figure. O(1) per trial: table-driven direct evaluation, fixed histograms, per-hit detail capped at 256 records per thread (1024 per arm). Pooling adds no per-trial storage. The declared figure is not approached.

execution_budget.machine_headroom_assumption: STATED EXPLICITLY: four-core host shared by three active AES campaigns under a max_concurrent = 3 task cap ACROSS ALL THREE; each arm is one four-thread process. Binding wall-clock sizing assumes arms run ONE AT A TIME (serial). Concurrency divides wall clock only; committed position order is preserved as the logical ordering; budget caps do not change with scheduling; honouring the cross-campaign cap takes precedence and if it would require running degraded the batch WAITS (goal head rule).
execution_budget.budget_discipline: Declared budgets are stop conditions, not estimates (C2): the executing batch stamps start_utc, declared_wall_clock_seconds and a computed binding_stop_utc, stamps every section boundary, and HALTS at binding_stop_utc with halted_on_budget recorded truthfully and the dropped work NAMED. A halt is infrastructure signal, never a negative mathematical result; dropped work is scope, never an answer.
